prompt: Acid cleavage of methyl phenyl ether (anisole) with excess HI, heat. Draw the two organic products.
explanation: Protonation of OAr; iodide attacks the SP³ methyl carbon (easy SN2), not the aromatic ring. Products are the phenol (Ar-OH) and methyl iodide. Aryl ethers always cleave on the alkyl side.
